decisions: The remote will be shaped like a snowman.
The remote will not have a talk-back function.
The remote will have a jog dial.
The materials used will be plastic and rubber.
The case will have a soft fruit-like feel to it.
The remote will not have an LCD display.
The remote will have a kinetic battery.
The remote will have rubber buttons.
action_items: Some team members will design a prototype of the remote
